raw:
@q query
  select ?place
  where all
    match
      relation "manage"
      role subject ?p
      role object "Mihai"
      polarity affirmed
    end
    match
      relation "live in"
      role subject ?p
      role location ?place
      polarity affirmed
    end
  end
